name: draftchamp
description: DraftChamp monorepo: React frontend (apps/web) + FastAPI backend (apps/api)

scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:api:fixture: cd apps/api && DRAFTCHAMP_LEAGUE_FILE=app/data/fixture_league.json uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.install:all: cd apps/web && npm install && cd ../api && uv sync --extra dev
